Good to
know.

Do I have to use the dealer to keep my factory warranty?

Generally, no. Under the federal Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act, a manufacturer can’t void your warranty or deny coverage just because maintenance was done by an independent shop.

Follow the factory maintenance schedule and keep your records. Repairs covered by the warranty itself are still handled by the dealer.

Are you affiliated with a manufacturer?

Houston Auto Pros is an independent European automotive shop with no manufacturer affiliation.

What happens after I send a request?

A request isn’t a confirmed booking. The shop reviews it and contacts you to confirm a time and talk through what your car needs.

Can I bring my car in if I’m not sure what’s wrong?

Yes — that’s where many visits start. Tell us what you’re noticing, and the visit begins with a conversation and a diagnostic plan before any repair decisions.

How does a pre-purchase inspection work?

Tell us about the car you’re considering and when you need an answer. The inspection focuses on condition, service needs and the questions that matter to your purchase, so you can decide with confidence.
